verdict.rationale: Aleph documents a first-party AI agent that users can tag in Slack with natural-language questions. It handles follow-up context and can update existing reports and dashboards or build new ones, and natural-language prompts configure its mapping agents. However, the evidence covers only answering questions, reporting and dashboard tasks, and mapping configuration, not operating the product broadly, and it is all vendor marketing. missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can drive the wider product (connectors, forecasts and scenarios, headcount plans, permissions), documentation of the agent's command scope and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
